description:
FILED s473t3 (Opus triage of the 79 CATALOG-only blessed rows), on main
d9a2aac0.  PRE-EXISTING.  Probes: scratch/s473t3/probes/p02-sprintf-markers.pl,
p03-sprintf-missing.pl.

ROWS BEHIND IT (baselines/fail-baseline.tsv, 4 rows):
  sprintf.t 227  `>%.0hf< >1< >%.0hf INVALID< >'h' should be rejected<`
  sprintf.t 482  `>%v%,%d< >[63, 64, 65]< >%v%,63 INVALID INVALID<`
  sprintf.t 494  `>%v#x< >''< >%v#x INVALID< ><`
  sprintf.t 553  `>%*2$d< >123< >123 MISSING< >123<`

HOW THE HARNESS SEES A WARNING: perl-tests/sprintf.t installs
`$SIG{__WARN__}` (line 74) and appends ` INVALID` / ` MISSING` / ` REDUNDANT`
to the expected string, so a row fails on the warning TEXT AND COUNT as well
as on the formatted output.  The file has `use warnings` at line 18.

THREE MEASURED SHAPES (perl 5.40.3 vs ./runpcl):
  (a) 227 -- `sprintf("%.0hf", 1)`
        perl: `%.0hf`  + warns `Invalid conversion in sprintf: "%.0hf"`
        PCL : `1`      + warns `Invalid conversion in sprintf: "%"`
      i.e. PCL HONOURS the `h` size modifier where perl rejects the spec and
      leaves it verbatim.
  (b) 494 -- `sprintf("%v#x", '')`
        perl: `%v#x` (verbatim) + INVALID
        PCL : `` (empty)
  (c) 482 -- `sprintf("%v%,%d", 63, 64, 65)`
        both print `%v%,63`, but perl warns TWICE
        (`"%v%"` and `"%,"`) and PCL warns ONCE (`"%"`).
  (d) 553 -- `sprintf("%*2$d", 123)` (positional width, index 2, one arg)
        both print `123`; perl warns `Missing argument in sprintf`,
        PCL warns NOTHING.  `sprintf("%s")` with no args DOES warn
        `Missing argument` in PCL -- so the miss is specific to an
        OUT-OF-RANGE POSITIONAL index.

Fix area: `p-sprintf` / `sprintf-one` in `cl/pcl-runtime.lisp`.

CATALOG NOTE THIS REPLACES: sweep-bug-catalog.md sprintf.t, "INVALID /
REDUNDANT / MISSING warning markers (biggest remaining group)".

NB the catalog filed sprintf.t 550 under the same note; it is NOT this
mechanism -- see #1473.

FAMILY: warning emission, adjacent to but NOT the same as #221 (warnings-gated
diagnostics): `Invalid conversion` and `Missing argument` ARE emitted by PCL
today, so this is accounting, not an absent category.
subject: BUG (sprintf): three shapes where the INVALID / MISSING warning accounting differs -- a size modifier is honoured instead of rejected (`%.0hf` -> `1`, perl `%.0hf`), an invalid vector spec formats instead of staying verbatim (`%v#x`), and an out-of-range POSITIONAL index warns nothing
